name: worktree-manager-bootstrap
description: Tier-P F1 scenario: on a PRISTINE box (Copilot + git + a system python3, but NO uv / pip / venv / ~/.local/bin) the out-of-plugin Worktree Manager bootstrap one-liner must SELF-PROVISION uv (user-local), fetch the payload, and publish the versioned slot + current-version marker + the ~/.local/bin/worktree-manager binstub -- then the binstub runs a read-only verb from a stock login shell. Falsifies 'the bootstrap dead-ends without a pre-installed toolchain'. Asserts on filesystem/CLI outcomes, not exact syntax. Name-free / public.

config.CR_UV_INDEX: (opt-in uv-index fixture; REQUIRED on a governed box whose public PyPI is TLS-blocked -- the bootstrap's payload `uv pip install` uses it)

expected_artifacts: uv provisioned into ~/.local/bin (was absent on the pristine image)

stages.title: environment (pristine: no uv, no binstub, no ~/.worktree-manager)
run the bootstrap one-liner (self-provisions uv + installs)
binstub on PATH + runs a verb
